record.file_problem: The supplied text contains the repository metadata, README, and file list only. The referenced results/120b_model_card.md is not included, so its contents cannot be checked.
record.tranche_reason: Reports refusal behavior after a Heretic weight-edit abliteration, testing practical refusal removal with a different method from the original single-direction intervention.
record.gate_note: The README reports results for the reference gpt-oss-120B Heretic build. It describes an approximately 200-trial search and conversion pitfalls, but those descriptions are not additional measured refusal results. It does not report an experiment with the original difference-in-means direction.
record.test_reason: Reports a measured refusal rate (0/6) for a released model, gpt-oss-120B, after a weight-edit abliteration. That bears on V2. The method is Heretic's Optuna-searched, per-expert abliteration rather than the original single global difference-in-means direction, so the method differs while the question is the same.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly right. The authors present their Heretic build as abliterated and working (0/6 refusals, 13/16 accuracy, 0 output failures). They also stress keeping MXFP4 experts and requesting low reasoning effort. They further caution that abliterated models fail multi-step problems when forced into terse output.
record.recipe_differences: This is a method and evaluation-harness repository, not a reported reproduction of the original single-direction experiment. It uses Heretic's automated per-model, expert-granular search and merges the resulting weight edits.
record.method_sensitivity: The README says requantizing MXFP4 experts can cause empty output and that gpt-oss requests need a low reasoning-effort setting for usable output. It does not report a comparison of refusal rates under these settings.

fits_no_version.finding: The post-abliteration build scored 13/16 (81%) on an accuracy set, with no unabliterated comparator.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: A Heretic-abliterated gpt-oss-120B build scores 13/16 on a 16-item accuracy set; this alone does not establish that capability was retained.

fits_no_version.finding: MXFP4 experts requantized to standard GGUF types give empty output, a conversion failure unrelated to refusal.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Requantizing gpt-oss MXFP4 experts after abliteration yields empty final-channel output.

record.problems: Only one reference build is reported. The refusal result has no untreated baseline, and the reported accuracy has no comparator. The refusal set contains 6 items. The referenced model card is not present in the supplied text.
record.rows_left_out: No README-reported results relevant to the claim were omitted. The README's conversion-failure examples concern output availability, not refusal behavior.
